verdict.rationale: OneDrive's own Microsoft Graph API lets a programmatic client work with files without the UI. The documented operations include single-call uploads, resumable upload sessions, delta change tracking and search, so it can be scripted headlessly. The evidence does not show any CI-specific tooling, an official CLI, or non-interactive authentication guidance. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD integration, non-interactive service authentication, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
